title: Explain the ArchiMate notation and add a non-technical entry point
requirements:
- Explain why the selected subset suffices and what it excludes
- Open 3.7 with a short recap of the 2.4 and 3.5/3.6 concepts it depends on
- Open 3.1 with a short health example tracing goal to component
- Add a short worked example (e.g. a national patient registry) illustrating realisation and adopt/adapt/map in practice
- Introduce ArchiMate/TOGAF terms such as capability and application component before Chapter 1 uses them
- Note that landscape diagrams may use more accessible notation, as Figure 3.2 does
- Keep a concise conformance explanation in the main chapter and move detailed ArchiMate/IHE conventions to an annex or separate specification
- Define an extension palette including Business Process, Business Role, Requirement, Constraint and Assessment
